svg.title: Preview, pin, and the touch policy
svg.desc: A three-state machine on two tiers. Resting and Previewing sit side by side on top: pointer movement with a non-touch pointer moves right into Previewing, and leaving the chart returns to Resting. Both drop to the accented Pinned state below on a click or tap; the edge from Resting notes that a touch pointer pins without previewing. From Pinned, clicking the pinned target again or Escape climbs back to Resting, a small self-loop marks re-pinning, and a dashed edge exits to a model or day swap, where the consumer chooses reset or carry by validAt.
